title: 20(S)-ginsenoside Rg3 suppresses gastric cancer cell proliferation by inhibiting E2F-DP dimerization.
authors: Li, Fuqiang; Cai, Chengyu; Wang, Fei; Zhang, Na; Zhao, Qingzhi; Chen, Yuyang; Cui, Xueli; Wang, Siyang; Zhang, Wenjie; Liu, Da; Cai, Yong; Jin, Jingji
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rg3通过分子对接与实验验证抑制E2F-DP二聚化从而影响胃癌增殖，涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关转录因子E2F，但核心是药物-蛋白结合而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅作辅助。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer (GC) is a common and aggressive malignancy, with treatment options often limited by drug resistance and the adverse effects of targeted therapies and immunotherapy. Ginsenoside Rg3, a bioactive compound derived from ginseng, has shown promise in inhibiting the growth of various tumor types, including GC. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying its therapeutic effects against GC remain insufficiently understood. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying the anti-cancer effects of ginsenoside Rg3 against GC. METHODS: To explore the molecular mechanisms underlying Rg3's anti-GC effects, RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) was conducted to identify potential Rg3-regulated targets. The interaction between Rg3 and E2F was analyzed using several approaches, including the cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), Rg3-PEGA pull-down, Rg3 pull-down protein mass spectrometry, and 3D molecular docking. Additionally, quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR), co-transfection followed by immunoprecipitation, Western blotting, flow cytometry, Annexin V-FITC staining, Hoechst staining, and luciferase reporter assays were employed to elucidate the molecular effects of Rg3. The inhibitory effect of Rg3 on GC proliferation was assessed through colony formation assays in vitro and tumor xenograft experiments in C57BL/6 mice in vivo. RESULTS: Rg3-mediated gene expression profiling in GC cells revealed several transcription factors, including E2F, and biological processes potentially influenced by Rg3. Consistent with these findings, Rg3 suppressed E2F expression and impeded GC cell proliferation by inducing G1/S cell cycle arrest, reducing cell growth both in vitro and in vivo, enhancing apoptosis, and inhibiting CDC6 transactivation. CETSA and Rg3 pull-down assays confirmed an interaction between Rg3 and E2F. Additionally, 3D molecular docking analysis demonstrated that Rg3 binds with high affinity to E2F at the heterodimeric domain via hydrogen bonding, potentially disrupting E2F-DP heterodimer formation and subsequently inhibiting cell cycle gene expression. In agreement with this, Rg3-treated GC cells exhibited reduced expression of cyclin D1, CDK4, cyclin A, CDK1, and CDK2. Moreover, Rg3 activated the tumor suppressors p53 and p21, further inhibiting RB phosphorylation by suppressing cyclin/CDK activity, thereby blocking transcription of G1/S transition-related genes. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first evidence that Rg3 directly binds to E2F proteins, disrupting E2F-DP heterodimer formation and inhibiting the transcription of E2F-DP-regulated target genes. Furthermore, Rg3 activates the p53-p21 pathway while suppressing the cyclin/CDK-RB signaling pathway, effectively inhibiting cancer cell proliferation. These findings highlight a potential therapeutic strategy for developing small molecules structurally similar to Rg3 to target tumors with high E2F expression.
abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌（GC）是一种常见且侵袭性强的恶性肿瘤，其治疗选择常受限于耐药性以及靶向治疗和免疫治疗的不良反应。人参皂苷Rg3是人参中提取的一种生物活性化合物，已显示出抑制包括胃癌在内的多种肿瘤生长的潜力。然而，其抗胃癌治疗效果的分子机制仍未被充分阐明。目的：本研究旨在阐明人参皂苷Rg3抗胃癌作用的分子机制。方法：为探索Rg3抗胃癌作用的分子机制，采用RNA测序（RNA-Seq）鉴定潜在的Rg3调控靶点。通过多种方法分析Rg3与E2F之间的相互作用，包括细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、Rg3-PEGA pull-down、Rg3 pull-down蛋白质谱分析以及3D分子对接。此外，采用定量逆转录PCR（qRT-PCR）、共转染后免疫沉淀、Western blotting、流式细胞术、Annexin V-FITC染色、Hoechst染色和荧光素酶报告基因实验来阐明Rg3的分子效应。通过体外集落形成实验和体内C57BL/6小鼠肿瘤异种移植实验评估Rg3对胃癌增殖的抑制作用。结果：Rg3介导的胃癌细胞基因表达谱分析揭示了多个转录因子（包括E2F）以及可能受Rg3影响的生物学过程。与这些发现一致，Rg3抑制E2F表达，并通过诱导G1/S细胞周期阻滞、降低体外和体内细胞生长、增强凋亡以及抑制CDC6反式激活来阻碍胃癌细胞增殖。CETSA和Rg3 pull-down实验确认了Rg3与E2F之间的相互作用。此外，3D分子对接分析表明，Rg3通过氢键以高亲和力结合至E2F的异二聚结构域，可能破坏E2F-DP异二聚体的形成，进而抑制细胞周期基因表达。与此一致，Rg3处理的胃癌细胞中cyclin D1、CDK4、cyclin A、CDK1和CDK2的表达降低。此外，Rg3激活肿瘤抑制因子p53和p21，通过抑制cyclin/CDK活性进一步抑制RB磷酸化，从而阻断G1/S期转换相关基因的转录。结论：本研究首次提供证据表明Rg3直接结合E2F蛋白，破坏E2F-DP异二聚体形成并抑制E2F-DP调控靶基因的转录。此外，Rg3激活p53-p21通路，同时抑制cyclin/CDK-RB信号通路，有效抑制癌细胞增殖。这些发现突显了一种潜在的治疗策略，即开发结构类似于Rg3的小分子以靶向高E2F表达的肿瘤。
